'''Kasuni Tamm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] who was an adventurer. Unbeknownst to her, she was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she and her pet [[Bogwing/Legends|bogwing]], [[Vaxim]], became involved in the search for a [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] at the [[Well of Shadows]]. She met [[Unidentified Jedi group|other Force-sensitives]] and was pursued by [[Sor Venge]], an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] who was also searching for holocron. However, she was able to flee with the others.

==Behind the scenes==
Tamm appears in the introductory story and gameplay example for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] book [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]].
